title: Workflow Card Schema
description: Schema defining a HarnessKit workflow card.

kind.description: Canonical kind discriminator for Workflow relation definitions

title.description: Authored human-readable display title for the workflow

domain.description: Functional domain this workflow belongs to. Preserves the grouping that flat storage would otherwise erase. Buckets map scm->scm, work->work, harness->harness; already-flat workflows default to core.

runtime_implemented.description: Whether the runtime implementation of this workflow exists

description.description: Human-readable description of the workflow's purpose

summary.description: Short description of what the workflow does

natural_language.description: Example natural-language phrases that trigger this workflow

examples.description: Example phrases that invoke this workflow

slash_commands.description: Slash commands that invoke this workflow directly

id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the workflow

title.description: Authored human-readable display title for this step

agent.description: component_id of the agent that executes this step

skill.description: component_id of the skill invoked in this step

rule.description: component_id of the rule consulted in this step

role.description: Authored execution role; it is metadata and not a Component incidence

prompt_template.description: Authored prompt template identity; it is metadata and not a Component incidence

output.description: Named output artifact from this step, referenced by later steps

requires_pass_from.description: Step id that must pass before this step

loop_back_to.description: Step id that receives control when this step loops

mode_fanout.description: Per-mode fan-out: maps a mode name to the set of agents that run in that mode for this step

agents.description: component_ids of agents that run in this mode

mode_policy_ref.description: Reference to the mode policy governing this workflow's execution
